references.text: Describes the sound of thundering horse hooves, an image of war horses in battle, similar to the image of the horses' hoofbeats in Deborah's song.
Mentions the gallop of strong horses, reminiscent of the powerful horses' galloping in Judges 5:22.
Describes horses that are faster than leopards, an image of mighty war horses in motion.
Mentions the sound of galloping horses and rattling chariots, reflecting the battle scene with horse hooves.
Describes the horse's strength and courage in battle, including its stamping hooves and fearlessness.
Compares the sound of locusts' wings to the sound of many horses charging into battle.
